description: A modern, minimalist interior scene with bold colors and geometric shapes. A dark blue chair with a sleek, angular design sits on a vibrant pink floor. The chair has a thin, red metal frame that contrasts with its dark upholstery. To the left, a large, bright red wall creates a striking backdrop, while a green palm leaf casts a shadow, adding a touch of nature to the scene. The right side of the image is dominated by a deep purple wall, enhancing the dramatic color contrast. The lighting is sharp, creating distinct shadows and highlighting the vivid colors.
